name: South Vietnam

flag.description: A yellow field with three thin horizontal red stripes across the center.
flag.symbolism: Yellow represented the Vietnamese people and land, and the three red stripes the three regions of Vietnam: north, center and south.

hook: South Vietnam is yellow with three thin red stripes through the middle; the Vietnam that absorbed it in 1975 flips the scheme to a yellow star on red.
trivia: The flag is still widely flown by Vietnamese communities abroad, especially in the United States, as the "Heritage and Freedom Flag".
After reunification, Saigon was renamed Ho Chi Minh City in 1976.
